description: Get qualified EA Hydrology flow, level, rainfall or groundwater time series for historical analysis. Use a Hydrology station SUID, property and matching statistic (rainfall typically total, level min/max); choose daily or 15min and ordered YYYY-MM-DD dates at most 366 days apart. Returns source data and provenance; supported hydrological units are normalised to SI. TerraMCP is a Wrench AI service. Open data: no API key or signup required. Anonymous limits: 60 calls/hour and 300/day per IP and session; keys offer higher limits, with anonymous fallback after monthly quota. Source licence warnings apply.

end.description: End date in YYYY-MM-DD; must be no earlier than start, at most 366 days apart.

property.description: EA Hydrology observed property; choose a statistic supported by that station's measures.

start.description: Start date in YYYY-MM-DD; must be no later than end, at most 366 days apart.

station_id.description: EA Hydrology station SUID from Hydrology metadata; not a flood-monitoring station ID.

statistic.description: Qualified measure statistic; rainfall typically total, levels min/max; default mean.

name: ea_hydro_series
